responsibility: Declares GCC’s internal JSON tree API: the json::value base class plus object, array, numeric, string, and literal subclasses, along with the kind discriminator enum. It defines the DOM-like ownership and printing interface used by other subsystems to construct ordered JSON documents in memory before serialization, rather than implementing any compiler-specific JSON schema itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface definition for the json group: it declares the json::value hierarchy, kind discriminator, and object/array/string/number/literal APIs. Unlike json.cc, which implements memory management and serialization, this header provides the in-memory JSON schema used by other GCC code.
